speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old male. The patient reports that the pain and swelling in his right ring finger began 2 days ago while playing football. He recalls his finger got caught in the jersey of another player, who then pulled away forcefully.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Flexor Tenosynovitis secondary to acute flexor tendon injury from sports trauma. The mechanism of injury (finger caught in jersey and forcibly pulled) strongly suggests an acute rupture or severe strain of the flexor digitorum profundus or superficialis tendons, leading to subsequent inflammatory swelling and pain.

DIAGNOSIS_READY_Answer: Rupture of the flexor digitorum profundus tendon at its point of insertion
